def keys_symmetric_diff(a, b):
    return sorted(set(a) ^ set(b))

def intersect_dicts(a, b):
    return {k: (a[k], b[k]) for k in a if k in b}

def filter_by_value_range(d, low, high):
    return {k: v for k, v in d.items() if low <= v <= high}

def filter_by_value_even(d):
    return {k: v for k, v in d.items() if v % 2 == 0}

def keys_with_single_occurrence(counts):
    return sorted(k for k, v in counts.items() if v == 1)

def keys_with_multiple_occurrences(counts):
    return sorted(k for k, v in counts.items() if v > 1)
